nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri 2 tray app and library engine
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home is the user's computer's disk and engine; the website on that computer is its screen (ADR 0104, 0051). It handles file I/O, analysis, streaming to other devices, and local link coordination on 127.0.0.1:47400-47409.

nodes.label: Native audio engine: crates/glue-audio in Rust
nodes.rationale: A line-for-line Rust port of the JavaScript analysis for GLUE Home, held to the website's results. Introduced incrementally: 0.44 linked, 0.45 every file, 0.46 used natively, 0.47 no audio JavaScript left, 0.48 DSD and JavaScript failure retries (ADR 0147, 0148, 0149).

nodes.label: GLUE folder: JSON files store (mco.json, profiles, collections, cache)
nodes.rationale: The user's data in JSON files, no database (ADR 0009). Profiles, collections with tracks, analysis, lists, sources, events, duplicates. Caches kept separately: in browser (OPFS) and GLUE Home (t/ w/ d/ p/ s/).

nodes.label: analysisState: done, failed, waiting, elsewhere, nofile states
nodes.rationale: One meaning of 'not analysed' everywhere: sidebar, Stats, analysis bar, both queues use this function to determine what needs analysis (ADR 0109).

nodes.label: Quality verdict mechanism: hi-res, lossless, verdict tiers and findings
nodes.rationale: Hi-res judged by content above 24 kHz (ADR 0116); lossless by steep top end with music-following content, no frequent drop-outs (ADR 0119). Rule changes bump VERDICT_VERSION and trigger re-judging.

hyperedges.label: Native analysis: GLUE Home's Rust engine analyzes songs, including DSD with PCM conversion
